name: concertina
title: Concertina
description: The page collapses into one bar of a row, the row slides to the slot belonging to the page you are going to, and that bar opens back out. GSAP.
docs:
Wrap your layout with the transition. This is the only step:

  // app/layout.tsx
  import { ConcertinaTransition } from "@/components/concertina"

  export default function RootLayout({ children }) {
    return (
      <html lang="en">
        <body>
          <ConcertinaTransition>{children}</ConcertinaTransition>
        </body>
      </html>
    )
  }

Your existing <Link>s are intercepted automatically.

The page collapses into one bar of a row, the row slides to the slot that
belongs to the page you are going to, and that bar opens back out. The slot
comes from a hash of the path, so a page always lands on the same bar with
nothing to configure.

Colour: four palettes ship as classes — palette="mono" (default), "inverse",
"ember" or "pine". For anything else pass palette="custom" and set --cc-ground
and --cc-slat yourself in components/transitions.css.

Note: browser back/forward is not animated, and the route does not start
loading until the leave phase finishes (~1s).
